candidates.title: Post Certificate Account Security Flow Reorder
candidates.change: Moves the sign-in screen to occur immediately after adoption certificate confirmation, allowing users to experience pet creation before auth.
candidates.why: 8 support emails complained about missing or reset pets after sign-in, while 26.9% drop off occurs during adoption creation prior to commitment.

guard.reason: Reordering sign-in after adoption certificate is explicitly allowed inside onboarding.

candidates.score_note: Targets adoption dropoff (26.9%) and resolves top support complaint (8 emails).

candidates.title: Desktop Companion Interactive Training Screen
candidates.change: Adds an interactive training screen right before completion where users practice hotkeys, hiding, and talking to their pet on screen.
candidates.why: 3 support emails reported confusion on how to control or hide pets, and 23.9% drop off at the final completion step.

new_desktop_rehearsal.headline: Practice Desktop Pet Controls
new_desktop_rehearsal.body: Learn how to summon, hide, and interact with your new companion on your screen.

components.text: Shortcut: Press Alt+Pet to open quick desktop controls menu.

guard.reason: Adding an interactive rehearsal screen inside onboarding before home intro is permitted.

candidates.score_note: Addresses high final step dropoff (23.9%) with interactive guidance.

candidates.title: Full Bleed Pet Persona Selection Workspace
candidates.change: Redesigns the friend picking screen into an immersive full-bleed grid workspace with companion personalities and visual styling options.
candidates.why: Adoption stage has a 73.1% conversion rate and a mean completion time of 1017s, indicating friction in friend selection.

pick_friend.headline: Choose Your Ultimate Desktop Companion
pick_friend.body: Select a personality type and visual style that fits your daily workflow.

guard.reason: replacement for 'pick_friend.pet_choices' does not do the job: needs 1 of ['choice_cards'] with real words

candidates.title: Desktop Companion Display Pre-Check Screen Flow
candidates.change: Inserts a pre-spawn diagnostic screen before waiting that verifies multi-monitor rendering and screen coordinates.
candidates.why: 3 support emails reported pets not rendering on desktop or failing to open, while the home step mean wait duration is 2336s.

new_display_test.headline: Verify Desktop Screen Compatibility
new_display_test.body: Ensure your display layout is ready for rendering your 3D pet companion.

guard.reason: Adding a screen display diagnostic test screen within onboarding flow is allowed.

candidates.score_note: Home step conversion is already high (96.0%), limiting potential lift.

candidates.title: Photo Lighting Quality Guidelines Hint
candidates.change: Displays a clear visual hint on the photo upload screen recommending high lighting contrast and front-facing poses.
candidates.why: 3 support emails reported custom pet generation failures or distorted visual results, contributing to adoption stage dropoff.

upload_photos.hint: Upload clear, well-lit photos facing forward to avoid 3D generation distortions.

guard.reason: Adding a visual guidance hint on the photo upload screen is permitted.

candidates.score_note: Low-cost hint targeting the highest dropoff step (adoption at 26.9%).

candidates.title: Starter Accessory Reward Unlock Incentive
candidates.change: Offers an exclusive founder badge accessory reward displayed on the final welcome screen upon finishing setup.
candidates.why: 23.9% of users drop off at the final completion step (finish step conversion is 76.1%).

home_intro.headline: Your Desktop Pet Is Ready to Play!
home_intro.body: Finish onboarding now to claim your exclusive Founder Crown companion accessory.

guard.reason: Onboarding copy must not mention gifts, free extras, or unlocked accessory rewards.

candidates.title: 3D Pet Generation Stage Breakdown Display
candidates.change: Provides real-time multi-stage rendering status text detailing mesh creation and behavior synthesis during spawn waiting.
candidates.why: The waiting screen has an exceptionally long mean wait time of 2336 seconds leading to dropouts.

waiting.headline: Synthesizing Your 3D Companion
waiting.body: Stage 1: Generating 3D Mesh -> Stage 2: Rendering Fur Textures -> Stage 3: Initializing Desktop AI.

guard.reason: text in 'waiting.body' has characters outside the allowed set: ['>']

candidates.title: Desktop System Tray Readiness Notification Alert
candidates.change: Enables an explicit opt-in system tray notification and audio alert when pet creation rendering finishes.
candidates.why: Users leave the application running in the background during long wait times (mean 2336s) and miss completion.

waiting.hint: We'll send a system tray desktop chime when your pet is ready to spawn!

guard.reason: Configuring opt-in readiness notifications during the waiting step is allowed.

candidates.score_note: Helps long 2336s mean duration, but target home step conversion is already 96.0%.

candidates.title: Account Persistence Data Protection Notice
candidates.change: Updates headline and body text to explain how account authentication protects custom pets from being reset or lost.
candidates.why: 8 support emails reported lost or reset pets after re-signing in or restarting sessions.

sign_in.headline: Secure Your Pet in the Cloud
sign_in.body: Signing in anchors your companion data safely to your cloud profile so you never lose your progress or customization.
sign_in.hint: Use your primary account to preserve pet data across device restarts.

guard.reason: Updating sign-in copy to explain data persistence preserves the original function of the sign-in step.

candidates.score_note: Config copy change backed by 8 support emails, though sign-in dropoff is low (7.3%).

candidates.title: Split Screen Path Selection Workspace Layout
candidates.change: Reconfigures the path choice screen into a side-by-side split screen comparing quick preset adoption versus custom AI generation.
candidates.why: Choose path screen has an 83.0% conversion rate with a large disparity between median 8s and mean 514s time taken.

choose_path.headline: Choose Your Onboarding Experience
choose_path.body: Select Instant Companion for quick setup, or Custom AI Generation to upload your own photos.

guard.reason: Split screen layout continues to offer both preset adoption and custom pet generation paths.

candidates.score_note: Reduces 514s mean hesitation time on choose_path (17.0% dropoff).
